lat: tzuwejt b bent khalti l-3am l-fayt
en: I married my maternal aunt's daughter last year.

lat: ma tzuwejtch 7it kunt baqi sghir
ar: ما تزوجتش حيت كنت باقي صغير
en: I did not get married because I was still young.

lat: wach tzuwejti b sa7ebtek mn l-jami3a
en: Did you (m.) marry your friend from university?

lat: nta ma tzuwejtich f had l-3am
en: You (m.) did not get married this year.

lat: nti tzuwejti bkri b weld 3mmek
en: You (f.) married your cousin early.

lat: nti ma tzuwejtich b hadak r-rajel
en: You (f.) did not marry that man.

lat: huwa tzuwej b tbiba f r-rbat
en: He married a doctor in Rabat.

lat: khuya ma tzuwejch f had s-sif
en: My brother did not get married this summer.

lat: khti tzuwjat b ustad dyal l-faransiya
en: My sister married a French teacher.

lat: hiya ma tzuwjatch 7tta kemmlat l-qraya
ar: هي ما تزوجاتش حتى كملات القراية
en: She did not get married until she finished her studies.

lat: 7na tzuwejna f chutenbir
en: We got married in September.

lat: ma tzuwejnach f l-mghrib
en: We did not get married in Morocco.

lat: wach ntuma tzuwejtu f fas
en: Did you (pl.) get married in Fez?

lat: ntuma ma tzuwejtuch b z-zerba
en: You (pl.) did not marry in a hurry.

lat: huma tzuwju f l-blad bkri
en: They got married in the village early.

lat: ch-chabab ma tzuwjuch f had l-weqt
en: The young guys did not get married at this time.

lat: ana kantzuwej b l-bent li kanbghi
en: I marry the girl I love.

lat: ana ma kantzuwejch bla 7ub
en: I do not marry without love.

lat: wach nta kattzuwej b bent mzyana
en: Do you (m.) marry a good girl?

lat: nta ma kattzuwejch f sin sghir
en: You (m.) do not marry at a young age.

lat: nti kattzuwji b rajel m3qul
en: You (f.) are marrying a respectable man.

lat: nti ma kattzuwjich b weld jiranek
en: You (f.) are not marrying your neighbors' son.

lat: huwa kaytzuwej b bent khalatu
en: He is marrying his aunt's daughter.

lat: sa7bi ma kaytzuwejch 7it ma 3nduch dar
ar: صاحبي ما كيتزوجش حيت ما عندوش دار
en: My friend is not marrying because he has no house.

lat: l-bent kattzuwej b muhandis
en: The girl is marrying an engineer.

lat: hiya ma kattzuwejch b ay wa7ed
en: She does not marry just anyone.

lat: 7na kantzuwju b n-nas d-drawech
en: We marry simple people.

lat: 7na ma kantzuwjuch bla rda l-walidin
ar: حنا ما كنتزوجوش بلا رضى الوالدين
en: We do not marry without parents' blessing.

lat: ntuma kattzuwju b n-nas mn l-blad dyalkum
ar: نتوما كتتزوجو بالناس من البلاد ديالكم
en: You (pl.) marry people from your village.

lat: ntuma ma kattzuwjuch bkri had l-ayam
ar: نتوما ما كتتزوجوش بكري هاد الأيام
en: You (pl.) do not marry early these days.

lat: n-nas kaytzuwju bezzaf f s-sif
en: People get married a lot in summer.

lat: huma ma kaytzuwjuch 7tta ykhedmu
en: They do not marry until they work.

lat: ghadi ntzuwej b bent 3emmi f l-3am j-jay
ar: غادي نتزوج ببنت عمي فالعام الجاي
en: I am going to marry my cousin next year.

lat: ma ghadich ntzuwej 7tta nkemmel qrayti
ar: ما غاديش نتزوج حتى نكمل قرايتي
en: I am not going to marry until I finish my studies.

lat: wach ghadi ttzuwej b l-bent li katbghi
ar: واش غادي تتزوج بالبنت لي كتبغي
en: Are you (m.) going to marry the girl you love?

lat: nta ma ghadich ttzuwej had l-3am
ar: نتا ما غاديش تتزوج هاد العام
en: You (m.) are not going to get married this year.

lat: wach ghadi ttzuwji b weld jiranek
en: Are you (f.) going to marry your neighbors' son?

lat: nti ma ghadich ttzuwji b dak l-weld
ar: نتي ما غاديش تتزوجي بداك الولد
en: You (f.) are not going to marry that guy.

lat: huwa ghadi ytzuwej b l-mu7amiya dyalu
en: He is going to marry his lawyer.

lat: khuya ma ghadich ytzuwej daba
en: My brother is not going to get married now.

lat: khti ghadi ttzuwej f ch-chher j-jay
en: My sister is going to marry next month.

lat: hiya ma ghadich ttzuwej b weld khaltha
ar: هي ما غاديش تتزوج بولد خالتها
en: She is not going to marry her aunt's son.

lat: 7na ghadi ntzuwju f s-sif
en: We are going to get married in the summer.

lat: 7na ma ghadich ntzuwju 7tta nlqaw khdma
ar: حنا ما غاديش نتزوجو حتى نلقاو خدمة
en: We are not going to get married until we find work.

lat: wach ghadi ttzuwju f l-mdina l-qdima
en: Are you (pl.) going to marry in the old city?

lat: ntuma ma ghadich ttzuwju f had z-zman
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تتزوجو فهاد الزمان
en: You (pl.) are not going to marry in this era.

lat: huma ghadi ytzuwju f 7efla kbira
en: They are going to get married in a big party.

lat: ch-chabab ma ghadich ytzuwju bla khdma
ar: الشباب ما غاديش يتزوجو بلا خدمة
en: The young guys are not going to get married without a job.
